summary: Not a classifieds page. A sepia collage of mastheads and headlines (Le Monde, Variety, Deutsche Zeitung, Gotlands Tidning, Herald Tribune). Useful only as a reference sheet for masthead and headline faces.

type.look: Fraktur / Old English mastheads (Deutsche Zeitung, De Telegraaf, Times)
Wide Latin / Clarendon woodtype (LE MONDE, Gotlands Tidning)
Heavy condensed gothic headlines (HEADLINE, EXTRA, WALL ST. LAYS AN EGG)
Art deco thin caps (THE ATLANTIC SUN)

notes: Exclude from the style families. The sepia toning and rotated mastheads could inform the microfiche 'film' look, not the ad pages themselves.
